inputs.split: five-fold sample-level cross-validation with deterministic shuffled folds

method.objective: relative held-out Frobenius reconstruction error after refitting non-negative exposures to held-out samples
method.convergenceRule: relative Frobenius-error improvement below tolerance; non-converged runs excluded from rank summaries
method.componentMatching: exact one-to-one permutation maximizing total cosine similarity; median matched cosine reported
method.stabilityRule: eligible ranks require all 5 folds, convergence rate >= 0.8, and median restart component stability >= 0.9
method.selectionRule: among eligible ranks, choose the smallest rank within one standard error of the minimum mean held-out error; exact ties resolve to the smaller rank
method.sampleClusteringRole: reported as mean pairwise adjusted Rand index across restart assignments; not used as a second tuning objective

selection.selectedRankReason: smallest eligible rank within one standard error of the best mean held-out error
